body: Reboot on 2026-07-16 hard-killed iduna.service mid-migration (202606250002_mmo_inventory.sql), applying ALTER TABLE items ADD COLUMN def_id/flags and CREATE TABLE character_equipment but never recording schema_migrations (RunSQLiteMigrations has no per-file transaction), so every restart retried from statement 1 and failed on duplicate column. Manually completed the 3 missing tables (character_inventory, character_key_items, character_bag_capacity) matching the real mysqlToSQLite output and recorded the migration. Separately found mysqlToSQLite's BIGINT-AUTO_INCREMENT regexes didn't match INTEGER-typed AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY columns (used in this migration and in 202606250003_monitors.sql), producing invalid SQLite (AUTOINCREMENT before PRIMARY KEY) that would have crashed the next migration too — widened the regexes to match BIGINT|INTEGER. commit: (pending)
title: post-reboot: fix migration translator INTEGER AUTO_INCREMENT bug + recover crash-looped 202606250002 migration
